searchText: Staked eth token is not fundamentally superior as it poses more risk it doesn't have the same risk profile The network will stop finalizing a while. Eventually that 40% will leak out and the network will automatically start finalizing again. It can take up to ~3 weeks though, so there will be a period of degraded service while the system recovers on its own. I don't know the specifics, but I believe that would slow down the rate of leaking, but the attacker would still lose money and eventually run out. But the chain would be finalizing intermittently during that time. Lets move this conversation to the #Deep Reorgs thread.
